name: What is the typical cost to replace a sliding door with an energy-efficient model?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to replace a sliding door with an energy-efficient model?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of replacing a sliding door with an energy-efficient model varies widely based on the door's size, material (e.g., vinyl, fiberglass, aluminum), glass options (e.g., double-pane, Low-E, argon gas), and installation complexity. Custom sizes or specific brand features can also influence pricing. Generally, expect a range that includes both the door unit and professional installation, which covers removal of the old door, preparation of the opening, and proper sealing. It's best to get a detailed quote for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on door size, material, glass options, and installation complexity. A detailed quote is recommended for accurate pricing.
